title: viburnum scabrellum
intro: Viburnum scabrellum, commonly known as Black Haw, is a deciduous shrub native to North America, known for its medicinal properties and ornamental value. The health benefits of Black Haw include its use in treating menstrual cramps, arthritis, and other inflammatory conditions, due to its analgesic and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Black Haw include its ability to relax smooth muscles, reduce pain, and exert antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents of Black Haw include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
